AI Augmented Softwre Engineer | High-Velocity AI Orchestration
Location: North Shore, Auckland (Hybrid)Department: Product EngineeringRole Type: Core Delivery
The MissionAt Straker, we are a dynamic, AI-centric company ranked in the top 60 of over 27,000 global vendors. We provide AI-based multilingual solutions to more than 50,000 customers in over 80 languages. Our Engineering team is a hive of innovative activity, solving hard problems that others can't.
As a Software Engineer, you are the primary delivery engine of our "Pods." You aren’t just a coder; you are an orchestrator of outcomes. You will use advanced AI orchestration to design, build, test, and ship solutions at a pace that traditional engineering cannot match. In our ecosystem, Velocity without Verification is a failure—we require both.
What You Will DoThis is a "High-Velocity" execution role where you will direct AI to produce high-quality outputs and verify them with surgical precision.
AI-First Development: Utilize Cursor, Claude, and Gemini as your primary mechanisms for feature development.
End-to-End Execution: Own the full stack from initial design to final deployment, translating loosely defined briefs into working software.
Rigorous Verification: Write and critically verify AI-generated test suites, ensuring they challenge the logic rather than just passing the "happy path."
Defensive Review: Actively hunt for hallucinations, logic gaps, and edge-case failures in AI-generated output.
Prompt Engineering: Maintain a "prompt log" to document how you steer AI, where it fails, and how you iterate for success.
Continuous Evolution: Stay on the "frontier" of AI tools and bring new techniques to your pod rituals.
What We Are Looking ForWe want engineers who have let go of manual methods that AI now handles better, without losing professional judgment.
Proven AI Track Record: Recent experience using AI tools to ship production software (not just side projects).
Prompt Mastery: Ability to write precise prompts and iterate rapidly when outputs miss the mark.
Technical Foundation: Solid engineering "DNA" to recognize when code is structurally sound or a "house of cards."
Healthy Scepticism: You treat AI as a capable but fallible collaborator, never as an absolute source of truth.
Pattern Recognition: You can spot common AI failure modes, such as shallow error handling or overconfident logic.
Ambiguity Tolerance: Comfort iterating toward a solution from a rough brief without waiting for perfect specifications.
Why Join Us?
Innovative Environment: Work in a pod structure designed for maximum autonomy and speed.
Modern Workspace: Join us in our light and bright Auckland North Shore offices, conveniently located adjacent to motorway offramps and the bus station.
Growth & Flexibility: We offer hybrid working and a culture that identifies talent and supports people to grow.
High-Level Impact: Spend less time on boilerplate and more time solving high-level problems using the most advanced AI tools on the planet.
Ready to build the future of multilingual tech? Join the Straker team today.
Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in New Zealand?
How many years' experience do you have as a Product Engineer?
What's your expected annual base salary?
